title: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NATIONAL FUND FOR
CULTURAL HERITAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance, to
amend the National Fund for Cultural Heritage Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 25th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
25-10-2002---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the National Fund for
Cultural Heritage (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: National Fund for Cultural Heritage Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6, Act VIII of 1994

NATIONAL FUND FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NATIONAL FUND FOR
CULTURAL HERITAGE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance, to
amend the National Fund for Cultural Heritage Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 25th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
25-10-2002---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 6, Act
VIII of 1994.---In the National Fund for Cultural Heritage Act, 1994 (VIII
of 1994), in section 6, in sub section (1), for clauses (i) to (vii), the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
(a) Federal Minister-in-charge
of Ministry of Minorities, Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs
Patron/Chairman
(b) Secretary Ministry of
Minorities, Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs
Member/Treasurer
(c) Joint Secretary. (Culture),
Ministry of Minorities, Culture, Sports, Tourism and Youth Affairs
Member/Secretary
(d) Finance Advisor (Culture),
Ministry of Finance
Member
(e) Director General, Federal
Department of Archaeology and Museums
Member
(f) Ten eminent professionals
in the field of Archaeology and National Heritage from private sector
nominated by the Federal Government
Members
